name: Chatty Eel 89
author: Cornerstone-04
description: Outlined black button that changes colour on hover.
howItWorks: On hover, text color changes to #fff, transform becomes scale(1). On focus, text color changes to #fff, transform becomes scale(1).
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Chatty Eel 89</title>
<style>
/* Chatty Eel 89 by Cornerstone-04 — https://uiverse.io/Cornerstone-04/chatty-eel-89 */
button {
  position: relative;
  background: none;
  border: solid 1px #121212;
  transition: linear 250ms;
  width: 100px;
  height: 40px;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
  font-size: 1rem;
}

button:is(:hover,:focus) {
  color: #fff;
}

button::after {
  position: absolute;
  content: '';
  inset: 0;
  z-index: -1;
  background-color: #121212;
  transform-origin: left;
  transform: scaleX(0);
  transition: linear 250ms;
}

button:is(:hover, :focus)::after {
  transform: scale(1);
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button>
    Button
</button>

</body>
</html>
